description: Election Commission - Declare that a member of the Karuwalagaswewa, Kebithigollewa, Pradeshiya Sabhas has Vacated his Office of member
reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices under Section 10 A (1) (a) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, specifically declaring that members of Pradeshiya Sabhas (local government bodies) have vacated their offices due to ceasing to be members of a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government, falling clearly under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including declarations about elected officials.
